name: CSO_TASK
description: This table contains the task records.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was modified.

columns.name: MODIFIED_BY_USER
columns.description: The name of the user that last updated the task.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID of the user associated with this record.

columns.name: OWNER_SITE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID of the repository that the task belongs to.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: ROLE_ID
columns.description: This has been deprecated from the schema.

columns.name: JOB_START
columns.description: Datetime the batch job ran that created task if created by a batch process.

columns.name: STATUS_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID to the current status record.

columns.name: TASK_NAME
columns.description: This is the name for the task in this record.

columns.name: TASK_TYPE
columns.description: Numeric value used as indicator of the lookupcode for the type of task.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_STEP_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID to the workflow step associated with the task if task is a workflow related task.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: This is the Reference to locale table record.

columns.name: CONTENT_ID
columns.description: This is the Reference to content table record.

columns.name: CONTENT_TEXT_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID to the content record the task is associated with if applicable.

columns.name: TOPIC_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID to the DBTOPIC record the task is associated with if applicable.

columns.name: MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID to the DBMESSAGE record the task is associated with if applicable.

columns.name: FORUM_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID to the DBFORUM record the task is associated with if applicable.

columns.name: SYSTEM_COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments dynamically created by system.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments entered by a user while performing a task if applicable.

columns.name: RESOLUTION
columns.description: System created comments based on the resolution of a task.

columns.name: TASK_ID
columns.description: This is the ID assigned to the task.

columns.name: TASK_ID_NUMBER
columns.description: The numeric portion of the task ID used for sorting.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID to a content recommendation associated with the task if applicable.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority of the task at this moment in time (0-Low, 1-Med, 2- High).

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Numeric value used as indicator of the lookupcode for status of task at this moment in time (0-New, 1-Open, 2-Unassigned, 3-Ignored, 4-Closed).

columns.name: USER_ASSIGNED_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID for the user the task is assigned to, null if unassigned.

columns.name: USER_ASSIGNED_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user the task is assigned to.

columns.name: USER_MODIFIED_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID for the user that modified the status record.

columns.name: USER_MODIFIED_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user that modified the status record.

columns.name: TASK_SUB_TYPE
columns.description: This is a custom task sub type for the record.

columns.name: USER_ASSIGNED_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID for the user the task is assigned to, null if unassigned.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user associated with this record.

columns.name: USER_MODIFIED_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID for the user that modified the status record.
